verdict.rationale: Fin's own docs say it is trained on and grounded in the customer's own knowledge base, with content imported from the help center, Zendesk, Confluence, Notion and websites. Nothing in the pack shows Fin displaying which article or source an answer drew from, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented source/article citations shown in answers, any guarantee that every answer is grounded, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every answer is grounded in my own content and shows which article or source it drew from

citations.quote: grounded in your knowledge base, and trained to apply your specific policies on every call.
Train Fin on your knowledge, data, policies, and tone of voice. Fin will use everything it knows to deliver consistent, accurate answers
Bring content from your help center, Zendesk, Confluence, Notion, and more into one place, so Fin, Copilot, and your team always work from the same source of truth.
